en.html:
Chachamaru"Not invited? My heart is wounded. Still, whoever comes, your situation is same-to-same, no?"
舞殿宮"...True. I lost. Take responsibility and die, that is all."
Chachamaru"Raichou, of all people, you join hands with. Then can't even control him. Ab kya karein—what can anybody do with that?"
舞殿宮"..."
Chachamaru"Too much hurry, Prince. That's where the game went wrong."
舞殿宮"Nothing to say in my defense. Say what you like. Next time, I shall do better."
Chachamaru"Next time..."
舞殿宮"A joke. A joke, I said. No need for that cold look."
舞殿宮"Kikuchi is waiting too. Could you take my head without further delay?"
Chachamaru"Your faithful Kamakura chief? That uncle would rather you stay alive and finish your work, wouldn't he?"
舞殿宮"............What a nasty disposition you have."
Chachamaru"Me?"
舞殿宮"Must you go out of your way to leave me regrets?"
Chachamaru"No, bhai. I'm saying, if living and finishing the work is what you want, I can arrange it."
舞殿宮"............"
Chachamaru"Arre? Where is the jumping for joy?"
舞殿宮"...I shall hear a little more before jumping. What are your conditions?"
Chachamaru"Nothing?"

Chachamaru"Safe delivery, free of charge. Yokohama will do, no?"
舞殿宮"GHQ...?"
Chachamaru"Correct. At present, you are a useful item for them."

Chachamaru"A go-between I will introduce properly. The Green Dragon SocietyGDG. A fairly shady lot, but they know GHQ's important people."
舞殿宮"...Green DragonGrüne Drache...?"

en.html:
Chachamaru"The rest depends on your skill. But easy enough, no? Look at the profit on their side."
Chachamaru"You represent Yamato and support the occupation army. League of Nations anti-war faction, mouth shut. The John Bulls can fight Rokuharaus without looking over their shoulders."
Chachamaru"Grand welcome, guaranteed. Three meals, afternoon nap, personal fan club included. Pakka arrangement, saab."
舞殿宮"...And you? What becomes of you?"
Chachamaru"Me? Shishiku and I struggle, naturally. Struggle upon struggle. Keep on thrashing."
Chachamaru"Make GHQ bring out even its trump card・・・."
Chachamaru"But finally, we lose. An army the citizens have abandoned cannot lastlast forever..."
Chachamaru"Rokuhara falls, I die, and Yamato lives peacefully ever after. Happy ending. Khatam."
舞殿宮"...Ideal."
Chachamaru"See? Done, then?"
舞殿宮"My answer? In that case..."
舞殿宮"I refuse. I shall die here."

舞殿宮 「返答か。 　そやな。それなら」
舞殿宮 「断る。 　ここで死ぬわ」

en.html:
Chachamaru"But why? Such a good offer, no complaint possible."
舞殿宮"True."
Chachamaru"You dislike becoming a dependency of the British CommonwealthBritain?"
舞殿宮"I do. But if that is the best way for Yamato's people, I think it must be accepted."
Chachamaru"Then where is your problem?"
舞殿宮"It is not a bargain."
Chachamaru"...Hmm?"
舞殿宮"You gain nothing. Just as you said: the occupation forces welcome me, Rokuhara is cornered, and you, one of its leaders, die."
舞殿宮"All loss on your side. Nothing in return."
Chachamaru"Haan. Such selflessness, Chachamaru Ashikaga. In a hundred years, maybe my face on a banknote."
Chachamaru"So? What's wrong with that?"
舞殿宮"A great deal. Someone who gives and gives, asks nothing, is either a true saint—or"
舞殿宮"a true devil, who takes everything in the end・・・・・・・・・・・・."
Chachamaru"————————"
舞殿宮"...Chachamaru. Let me hear what you want."
舞殿宮"Truly nothing? Then say so. Say it with that face unchanged・・・・・・・, and I shall believe you."
Chachamaru"............"
舞殿宮"...What do you want?"
